ingus_1.m: Hello there. I don't think I have seen you here in Remgard before.

ingus_2.m: Oh, there's not much happening around here. We try to keep the town as peaceful as possible.

ingus_3.m: We don't get many visitors up here in the mountains.

ingus_4a.m: However, lately there has been some trouble here in town.
r: Never mind that, is there a shop in town?

ingus_4b.m: Hopefully, we'll get a few more visitors now that you've helped us with figuring out what happened to the people that went missing.
r: Is there a shop in town?

ingus_q1.m: Unfortunately, for whatever reason, people that live in their neighborhood have been reporting the situation between the two of them has recently become more ... shall we say ... 'noticeable'.

ingus_q2.m: I'm afraid that if they don't resolve their differences soon on their own, that the city council will have to act and resolve the matter for them.

ingus_q3.m: It wouldn't be the first time the city council had to intervene in private matters that got out of hand.

ingus_r1.m: Hello again. I hope you enjoy your stay in Remgard.

ingus_s1.m:
Shop? Oh yes, of course. There's Rothses' and Arnal's shops right there.
[Ingus points to the two nearby houses to the west]

ingus_s2.m: Also, if you have the coin, you can always spend it in the tavern down in town.
r: Thank you. What is happening around town?
What is there to do around here?
Is there a shop in town?

ingus_t1.m: Oh, I don't know much about it. The guards say they have seen strange signs outside town, and some people have gone missing.

ingus_t2.m: I try to keep out of it though. Sounds like trouble to me.

ingus_t3.m: Well, there's always the Elwille sisters, fighting as always.

ingus_t4.m: Last night, they must have kept the whole town awake, the way they were shouting at each other.

ingus_t5.m: Oh ... nothing ... everything. I don't know. No one really puts much weight in their squabbling.

ingus_t6.m:
They live in one of the cabins on the southern shore.
[Ingus points to the south]
r: Thank you, I might go visit them. Goodbye.
Thank you. I wanted to ask you, is there a shop in town?

sisterfight.10: I heard a story about two squabbling sisters in Remgard, Elwel and Elwyl. Apparently they have kept people awake at night with the way they are shouting at each other. I should go visit them in their house on the southern shore of the city of Remgard.
sisterfight.20: I have talked to Elwyl, one of the Elwille sisters in Remgard. She is furious at her sister for not agreeing on even the most simple of facts. Apparently, they have had their disagreements with each other for several years.
sisterfight.21: Elwel will not speak to me.
sisterfight.30: One matter that the sisters disagree on currently is the color of a certain potion that the town potion-maker Hjaldar used to make. Elwyl says that the potion of accuracy focus that Hjaldar used to make was a blue potion, but Elwel insists that the potion was a green substance.
sisterfight.31: Elwyl wants me to get a potion of accuracy focus from Hjaldar here in Remgard so that she can finally prove to Elwel that she is wrong.
sisterfight.40: I have talked to Hjaldar in Remgard. Hjaldar no longer makes potions since his supply of Lyson marrow extract has gone dry.
sisterfight.41: Apparently, Hjaldar's old friend Mazeg would surely have some Lyson marrow extract to sell. Unfortunately, he does not know where Mazeg currently lives. He only knows that Mazeg traveled far to the west last time they met.
sisterfight.45: I should find Mazeg and get some Lyson marrow extract so that Hjaldar can start making potions again.
sisterfight.50: I have talked to Mazeg in the Blackwater mountain settlement. Since I helped the people of the Blackwater mountain before, he is willing to sell me a vial of Lyson marrow extract for only 400 gold.
sisterfight.51: I have talked to Mazeg in the Blackwater mountain settlement. He is willing to sell me Lyson marrow extract for 800 gold.
sisterfight.55: I have bought some Lyson marrow extract from Mazeg. I should return to Remgard and give it to Hjaldar.
sisterfight.60: Hjaldar thanked me for bringing him the marrow extract.
sisterfight.61: Hjaldar can now create potions again, and is willing to trade with me. He even gave me some of the first potions that he made. I should go visit the Elwille sisters here in Remgard again, and show them a potion of accuracy focus.
sisterfight.70: I have given a potion of accuracy focus to Elwyl.
sisterfight.71: Unfortunately, it did not cause their squabbling to diminish. On the contrary, they seem to be even more angry at each other now, since both of them had the color wrong.

remgard2.10: I have told Jhaeld, the village elder in Remgard, about the woman named Algangror that lives in the abandoned house to the east along the northern shore of the lake outside Remgard.
remgard2.20: Jhaeld told me that he would rather not deal with her, since he believes she is very dangerous. For the sake of his guards, he will not risk going against her since he is afraid of what might happen to all of them.
remgard2.21: If I want to help Jhaeld and the people of Remgard, I should find a way to make Algangror disappear. He also warns me to be extremely careful.
remgard2.30: Algangror admitted to me that she had made some people disappear from Remgard. She would not tell me what happened to them though.
remgard2.35: I have started attacking Algangror. I should return to Jhaeld with proof of defeating her when she is dead.
remgard2.40: I have told Jhaeld that I defeated Algangror.
remgard2.41: Jhaeld was very pleased to hear the good news. The people of Remgard should now be safe, and the town can be opened to outsiders again.
remgard2.45: For helping the people of Remgard find the cause of the disappearing people, Jhaeld told me to talk to Rothses. He might be able to improve some of my equipment.
remgard2.46: Ervelyn, the Remgard tailor, gave me a feathered hat as thanks for helping the people of Remgard find out what happened to the missing people.

sk.fightstyleUnarmedUnarmored: Fighting style: Way of the monk
